title: The loop releases backlog only while the test queue has room and holds a lands-alone item until the test and merge stages clear
description: Seeds 8 backlog items (7 ordinary and 1 marked landsAlone), 24 allowed workers and 3 trial slots with a stub trial that takes 3 cycles, and asserts the test queue never exceeds 6 and the lands-alone item is released last.

steps.name: test queue stays at or below twice the trial slots and lands-alone releases last
